sources: WEDNESDAY Sep 23 2026 RUN. HEADLINE: the curve backed away from the brink. 2s10s widened 5bp to 0.25 from 0.20 (24/7 Wall St macro release), reversing Tuesday's flattest print of 2026, with the 10y holding near 4.95-4.97 pct. The rest of the risk complex eased with it. VIX 14.21 (Sep 22 close, -4.4 pct, a 21-session low, down from 16.20 - confirmed by both the Yahoo Finance auto-run and press reports). HY OAS 268bp (FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2, Sep 18, in from 276). MOVE 78.6 (Yahoo auto-run; mid-September vendor prints 77.9-80.6). Brent 98.61 on a fifth consecutive down session (TradingEconomics/Yahoo Sep 22, approx -1.9 pct d/d, futures near 98 on Sep 23) as credible US-Iran diplomacy unwinds the geopolitical premium that peaked at 130.80 on Sep 15 - the first sustained sub-100 handle since the spike. DXY 100.54 (Sep 22 close, +0.11 pct, highest in 21 sessions) with the Fed hiking. Copper 6.70 USD/lb (sixth straight gain) over gold 4,307.63 USD/oz gives copper/gold 1.57, up from 1.54 - mildly pro-cyclical. 5y5y breakevens 2.34 (FRED T5YIFR, Sep 17), essentially unchanged. NFCI DATA FLAG: the Sep 23 release (week ending Sep 18) was due 08:30 ET but no numeric print could be retrieved - the Chicago Fed page renders client-side and FRED had not propagated at run time. CARRIED at -0.56 (week ending Sep 11), the loosest of the cycle. BDTI DATA FLAG: carried at 4,899 for a THIRD consecutive run with no dated Baltic print located; vendors remain irreconcilable (Investing.com approx 1,107; MacroMicro 2,068 in May 2026). The Baltic Exchange weekly report for Sep 4 does show VLCC TD3C at WS677.22 with round-trip TCE near 704,000 USD/day and TD15 at WS236.88 - an extraordinarily strong dirty tanker market, at least directionally consistent with a very elevated index. Treat the exact level as LOW CONFIDENCE. CARRIED with no fresh prints: initial claims 196k (week ending Sep 12; next release Thu Sep 24), ISM manufacturing 54.6 (August), UMich consumer sentiment 47.8 (September preliminary; final Sep 25), building permits 1,394k (August), LEI y/y approx -0.7 pct (August), Sahm rule -0.07, SOFR-OIS 0bp and EUR/USD 3M xccy basis -10bp (both standing assumptions, no free live source), global liquidity 1 (stable). NOTE: this run was committed via git plumbing because stale HEAD.lock and index.lock files in .git could not be removed from the sandbox (read-only mount permissions); the commit was built on the remote tip e5e4afb. PICTURE: a broad easing across the risk complex - vol down, credit tighter, oil below 100, curve steeper - which removes the immediate inversion scare but changes nothing structural. The soft spots are unchanged and entirely domestic: UMich 47.8 near record lows, LEI negative y/y, permits falling, and a Fed hiking into that. WATCH: claims (Sep 24), UMich final September (Sep 25), ISM (Oct 1), whether Brent stabilises below 100, and whether the 2s10s steepening holds or resumes flattening toward zero.
